name: Luke Simpson
description: Luke Simpson is an 18-year-old aspiring entrepreneur and AI developer based in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. A graduate of Asquith Boys High School, he is developing Clyra AI and building practical skills in artificial intelligence, software development, automation, and technology entrepreneurship.
